settings.label: Zoom it opens at
settings.help: Wide, Region, Local, Area, City or Close, each twice as close as the one before; the scale bar at the foot of the radar says how far. Press and turn the knob on the radar to zoom; this is where it starts.

settings.label: Lightest rain
settings.help: The radar sees 10 dBZ and up: drizzle, rain that evaporates before it lands, mist. A ground station often calls that dry. Drizzle and up starts at 15 dBZ, light rain at 20, steady rain at 25. The theme's colours stay the same; weaker echoes are just not drawn.

settings.label: LibreWXR source
settings.help: Radar: LibreWXR (CC BY 4.0) from national radar services, NOAA and ECMWF via Open-Meteo. Empty uses the public server, https://api.librewxr.net; a server you run yourself takes its address here.
